value.rationale: The all-parameter classification of continuous vertex-feedback resources exposes a counterintuitive reentrant design: the larger, lower-degree vertex class alone is optimally anchored over an intermediate budget interval, but both communities are anchored at low and high budgets. The cubic boundaries and unique global allocations are reusable control-design facts; the result is not a renamed KKT condition, a numerical special case, or fixed-cardinality leader placement.
